system.description: A bracelet that merges a microframe computer, sensor pack and small fabricator. It performs the functions of a Chrono, Data Slate, Combi-Tool, Torch, Multikey and Pict Recorder, never runs out of power, keeps its own time, and has a magical compass and altimeter that work in any environment.
system.effectText: Bracelet combining chrono, combi-tool, data slate, multikey, pict recorder, torch, plus compass and altimeter.
